design_brief.subject: Skill-force — max adult Major_* skills on every household Sim/Servo so activities and unlockables are not gated
design_brief.audience: operators and Windows host agents who need DIY and other skill unlocks immediately usable
design_brief.job: Reusable catalog + mode-agnostic cheat planner: soft-focus → Ctrl+Shift+C → testingcheats enabled true → stats.set_skill_level lines → bounded ACCEPT_OFFERED_REWARD_TRAIT. full_unlock defaults to level 10. Household mode counts any N members, Space-traverses each, skips skills already recorded complete, Spaces past fully-done members to the next Sim that still needs work, and now runs foreground-only: detached game input cannot verify the current selected portrait. Required residuals Cooking/Fitness/Natural Living re-dispatched at end unless already complete. Not BI-005.
design_brief.architecture: Sibling to funds_inject / household_object_force. Distinct from read-only sim_profile and aspiration life-state OK. No second skill/trait daemon. Typing owner: scripts/win32_input.type_text (keybd_event). P100 cohesive household traverse + completion ledger live in this same owner.
design_brief.operator_correction: Do not stop at one Sim. N is the observed Live household portrait count — whatever that household is — not an invented ceiling. After a save reload that undoes progression, bootstrap the household with skill-round-robin: one skill for every portrait, then the next skill for every portrait, until all requested skills are level 10. Do not dump every skill onto one Sim before Space. Do not retype skills already maxed on the current Sim. Space between members, skip already-complete skill×member cells, include Cooking/Fitness/Natural Living with correct internal ids (Major_HomestyleCooking, Skill_Fitness, Skill_NLS), and never launch a detached concurrent UI worker; a single foreground owner must attest each portrait and preserve the roster. Do not add Sims/Servos or go online. Opt-in bootstrap entry: python bootstrap.py household-skills -- --members N ... (never autorun on install). Keep Live paused during precious-time dispatch; verify with PLAY_BRIEF → Skills panel LOCAL_OBSERVED → REPAUSE. Console text and LEVEL UP toasts are not PASS. Ledger DISPATCHED is resume/skip evidence only.

statuses.DISPATCHED: Host typed stats.set_skill_level at target — resume/skip only; not panel PASS; never narrate as maximized
statuses.PANEL_OBSERVED_MAX: Optional stronger mark after Skills-panel LOCAL_OBSERVED
statuses.PANEL_FALSIFIED: Skills-panel LOCAL_OBSERVED contradicted DISPATCHED maximize claim; clears skip until redo

completion_ledger.skip_skill_when: DISPATCHED only means typed (resume/avoid duplicate commands), not proof of max level; reconcile stale/session/roster state before skipping. PANEL_OBSERVED_MAX requires genuine Skills panel observation. PANEL_FALSIFIED never skips.
completion_ledger.skip_member_when: no remaining skills for the requested bundle after ledger filter

live_hotkey_arm.purpose: Interruptibly borrow Sims, terrain-RMB arm Live hotkeys, restore the operator's app
live_hotkey_arm.operator_rule: Borrow Sims briefly, right-click exposed world/terrain to arm Live hotkeys, then restore the operator's foreground app.
live_hotkey_arm.operator_detail: Terrain RMB arms hotkeys. The operator may be in YouTube or any other app — snapshot → borrow → RMB → restore so they keep control of their computer. Prior LMB→RMB also worked but left-click is not required. Composes with ASYNC_INTEROP 15s idle.

interruptibility.note: Play-brief waits with operator app restored; never leave user trapped in Sims

live_hotkey_arm.world_point_note: Skill-force uses ONE pinned terrain arm point (default [880,480]). Do not roam street corners, zoom out, pan the lot, or click around the map — that disrupts the operator and does not level skills. Never a fixed-ui-click-map seed (portraits, trays, strip, burger, TR HUD, calendar, …).

hud_exclusion_bands_1920x1080.note: Bands cover top chrome, household/portrait/console strip, whims, BR trays

skill_progress_extrapolator.formula: remaining = ceil((target - after) / delta) when delta > 0

panel_record.purpose: Persist Skills-panel LOCAL_OBSERVED levels so agents do not require repeated operator screenshots

statuses.PANEL_OBSERVED: Exact observed level below target — gap remains for sequential upgrade
statuses.PANEL_OBSERVED_MAX: Observed at/above target — durable skip for maximize cells

panel_record.roster: household_roster.members is exact Live portrait count N; never invent portraits

household_traverse.arm_note: Left-click in the world, right-click to cancel options, then Space. Bare Space without arm fails when focus is not in the game.
household_traverse.member_count_note: Pass exact observed Live household portrait count as --members N. N is whatever that household is. Host does not invent size and does not treat 8 or 10 as the product ceiling — sanity_max_members is anti-runaway only. Only one foreground executor controls Space-traverse. Reobserve exact ordered portrait identity after any roster change; stop and reconcile, never silently expand.
household_traverse.dispatch_order_note: For each skill in catalog/bundle order: visit every portrait (Space), set that one skill to target, then advance to the next skill. Fairer after save-reload than member_then_skills (all skills on one Sim before Space).
household_traverse.bootstrap_cli: python bootstrap.py household-skills -- --members N --bundle full_unlock --execute --roster-key PORTRAIT_1 [--roster-key PORTRAIT_2 ...] --first-portrait-attested --process-id PID --session-id ID
household_traverse.console_lifecycle: Each cell closes the console; do NOT toggle console again before Space. Reopen only inside the next admitted cell.
household_traverse.selected_member_validation: First portrait locally attested before run; exact roster stable and fresh per cell in local game host; offline policy cannot by itself prove real UI identity.

inject_sequence.close_console_note: Prefer Ctrl+Shift+C toggle. Escape while Live often opens pause MENU and breaks Space household traverse.
inject_sequence.open_console_chord_note: Use send_key_chord so CTRL+SHIFT stay held for C. Manual send_vk/tap sequences can drop SHIFT and fire bare C (screenshot) instead of the console.
inject_sequence.cheat_line_submit_note: computer_type newlines do not submit Sims cheat lines. Durable host: re-click console strip then type_text(cmd + '\n') so Enter is keybd_event inside the typing owner.
inject_sequence.selection_note: Commands apply to the currently selected Sim/Servo only.
inject_sequence.typing_note: Prefer keybd_event VkKeyScan typing; KEYEVENTF_UNICODE alone is a silent miss on some TS4 DirectInput hosts.

reward_dialog_accept.purpose: Confirm offered skill-mastery / reward-trait OK dialogs during skill force so unlockables are not left modal-blocked
reward_dialog_accept.harmful_trait_note: 2026-11-09 incident: a new Servo accepted Evil and caused laundry fires. If the offered reward/trait classifies as Evil/harmful the only allowed dialog input is Escape-cancel of THAT dialog (never Enter/OK, never a coordinate OK click). Unclassified dialogs HOLD. never_press_cancel still applies to benign mastery traits.

skills_panel_observation.paused_panel_note: Skills UI does not reliably refresh while Live is PAUSED; do not treat a paused-only screenshot as residual-skill failure or as max-level proof.
skills_panel_observation.keep_paused_policy: During precious-time / unfinished main-goal work, keep Live paused for skill cheat dispatch and long idle. Do not leave 1x/2x/3x running.

play_brief_for_fresh_panel.purpose: Bounded Live tick so Skills panel refreshes; capture/analyze; immediately re-pause — no terrain RMB (map noise)

trait_safety.extension_rule: Append a harmful trait id here only with a LOCAL_OBSERVED console/CAS id; never remove an entry.

trait_repair.purpose: Console repair plan for the currently selected Sim after an unwanted Evil trait: traits.remove_trait trait_Evil
trait_repair.live_gate: LOCAL_OBSERVED trait removal on the selected Sim (CAS/Traits panel) before any PASS claim; console text is not PASS

escape_as_household_traverse_close.reason: Escape opens the Travel map / pause MENU and breaks Space household traverse

escape_spam.reason: Repeated Escape opens the Travel map / pause MENU; one deliberate Escape-cancel of an observed dialog is the only allowed use

success: OBSERVE household portrait count N (whatever the household is) → --members N
LOAD completion ledger (session_id + member key/index); omit already-complete skills unless --redo
RESOLVE skill ids or bundle (full_unlock + mandatory residual_core tail)
DISPATCH_ORDER skill_round_robin (default): FOR each skill in order:
if not first cell: CLOSE console → SPACE (SELECT_NEXT_HOUSEHOLD_SIM; wraps after last portrait)
if skill already complete for this member: SKIP_DISPATCH → continue
SET_SKILL_LEVEL for this one skill; RECORD DISPATCHED in completion ledger
optional --detach: spawn opt-in worker; return receipt path immediately
bootstrap.py household-skills forwards the same household CLI (never autorun on install)
Emit receipt; execute_allowed=false until independent screen_admit; ledger DISPATCHED ≠ panel PASS
